purpose: predeclared SDC physical target response; not training or main-matrix target selection
io_policy: fixed absolute max input/output delay, min 0; both core and virtual IO clocks vary together

fixed.flow: frozen ASAP7 settings, no retiming or new templates

starting_point: fresh synth in each directory; identical input RTL and ABC target; verify normalized mapped-netlist equality before interpreting physical response
interpretation: compare cell/master/physical netlist and common-SDC path metrics, never slack alone; failures limit conclusions to completed stages; no extra target scan
axes: ABC target and SDC target both remain in measurement identity/cache keys
